papers.title: Biopsychosocial profile in individuals with chronic low back pain and high central sensitization symptoms: a cross-sectional comparative study.
papers.reason: The cross-sectional biopsychosocial comparison does not indicate an interactive cognitive task, eye tracking, qualifying EEG analysis, or a generative cognitive model.

papers.title: Brain network biomarkers for diagnosis and clinical stratification in multiple sclerosis: a longitudinal study integrating individualised structural covariance MRI with high-density EEG.
papers.reason: High-density EEG is central to longitudinal brain-network biomarker analysis in human multiple-sclerosis cohorts, although no behavioural task, eye tracking, or cognitive process model is specified.

papers.title: RobustPDx: A Structured Web-Based Parkinson’s Assessment Dataset and Benchmark for AI Robustness to Device Type and Handedness
papers.reason: Human participants complete interactive web-based motor and working-memory tasks that yield task-level behavioural data for Parkinson’s digital biomarker development.
